A '''B1 battle droid sergeant''' commanded three [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s aboard the ''[[Devastation]]''. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].
